IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - high error rate (504) for embeddings-service-eu-west (alert id: ab12cd34). Estimated customer impact: 3% of requests failing.

Maria: taking this as primary. quick summary: around 20:05 UTC saw a spike in 504s backing embeddings in eu-west, coincident with autoscaler churn and a routing weight spill to a small pool. I've disabled the canary routing override and paused autoscaler to stop flapping.

Alex: +1 — I'm on secondary. pulling logs now, will check for OOMs and connection resets.

Samir: saw the initial alert in the dashboard, looks like a small fleet lost readiness probes. probably an image-side regression? I'll grep recent deploys.

Maria: actions taken so far:
- disabled canary weights -> reverted routing to stable pool
- paused embeddings-autoscaler in eu-west (policy: scaleDownCooldown)
- increased pool size by 2 nodes (manual bump) to absorb traffic
- raised per-node connection limit to 1200 via envoy config (temporary)

Kai: runbook link for this class of failure: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-504 (see section "routing spill + autoscaler oscillation"). Recommend following the "stabilize routing" checklist if we see more than one recurrence in 15m.

Maria: current telemetry:
- p50 latency steady, p95 elevated (~620ms)
- error rate down from 3.1% -> 0.9% after the manual pool bump and rollback
- no new deploys in the last 10m on eu-west

OncallRunner: quick pointers/links:
- Dashboard: https://observability.redwood/d/embeddings/eu-west
- Logs (last 30m): https://logs.redwood/query?service=embeddings&region=eu-west
- Autoscaler events: `kubectl -n inference get hpa embeddings-autoscaler -o yaml`

Alex: found repeated readiness probe timeouts on node gpu-23, same timeframe as the alert. stack traces show a small memory spike right before restart. sample log: ```
2026-09-04T20:04:52Z embeddings[pid=1234] WARN kv_cache: allocation failed: OOM
2026-09-04T20:04:53Z kubelet kubelet: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503
```

Samir: i traced recent deploys — a model-quantization canary went live in the small pool at 20:02 UTC (deploy id: deploy-qa-778). rolling that back now.

Maria: rolling back canary confirmed. monitoring effects.

Kai: note for oncall rotation: primary should keep autoscaler paused until p95 < 400ms for two consecutive 5m windows or until SRE approves resume. secondary to watch for new routing overrides in the console.

Alex: after rollback, error rate dipped further. graphs show error rate trending down over the last 6m.

Maria: status update -> degraded -> stabilizing. customer impact reduced to ~0.4%. No customer-facing alerts sent; CS informed via DM to standby if customers report issues.

Samir: follow-up tasks (short):
- investigate memory footprint change in quantized model path (assign: Samir)
- add guard in canary rollout to block routing weights < 10% for pools with < 5 nodes (assign: Maria)
- create alert refinement to correlate readiness probe failures with autoscaler events (assign: Alex)

Kai: longer-term: consider autoscaler hysteresis tuning and probe timeout increase for model load windows. put on next infra sync agenda.

Maria: handoff notes for next shift (starting 21:00 UTC):
- primary: Alex (picking up at 21:00)
- secondary: Kai
- current state: embeddings-eu-west degraded->stabilizing, manual pool bump in place, autoscaler paused, canary rolled back
- immediate checks for next: verify autoscaler remains paused, watch p95 and error rate for 30m, confirm no new routing overrides (console -> routing -> recent changes)
- escalation path: if error rate >1.5% or p95 > 800ms persist for >10m, page #eng-sre and tag @SRE-Leads (pager policy).

OncallRunner: scheduled reminders -> 10m and 30m monitoring pings to this thread.

Alex: ack, will pick up at 21:00. leaving my contact: +olark alex (DM) if anything spikes.

Maria: final note: please add any troubleshooting commands you use to the runbook as inline snippets, saved under "eu-west emergency ops". thanks team. :thumbsup:

Kai: noted. adding playbook PR after incident cool-down.

IncidentBot: Incident state changed -> MONITORING.

Alex: thanks, taking over.

Samir: leaving investigation notes in the ticket. will follow up tomorrow with a root-cause draft.
